note: Advisory baseline for D-159. Counts only — which of these are false positives is a reading, not a number, and is deliberately not decided here. A rule is a candidate for promotion to blocking once its findings have been read and its false-positive rate is known. The per-repository rule counts under `repositories` are also a ratchet (AL-024): `bun run rules:ratchet` fails when one rises and lowers it when one falls. The totals under `rules` are from the last full run.
